propositions: Command syntax is fragmented across imperative argv loops, hand-maintained help files, and inline argparse, causing drift between runtime parsing, documentation, and help output.
A canonical parser registry and factory protocol must be established to generate deterministic, byte-identical help and overview artifacts without duplicating grammar across frameworks.

All command families (core: ticket/store/config/maintenance; advanced: bridge/reconciler/LLM/workflow/audit/identity) must migrate from imperative or inline parsing to side-effect-free argparse factories with argv parity verification.

Top-level routing must be cut over to serve generated help and command discovery from the registry before operation/config/store/handler boundaries, while preserving the compatibility route ladder for execution.
